svg.text: Image filtering on the TPU: 4 filters, one matrix multiply
Left: the 10 x 10 input. Right: the 4 feature maps as read back from the chip's Unified Buffer after the Verilog run
(rows 192-255, v2_pipelined, 291 cycles). im2col turned 64 sliding 3 x 3 windows into 64 rows of one matrix.
Amber grids: the filter weights (one column of W each). Colors: 0 = dark, largest value = light.
